title: Mike Turner, Wright-Patterson donors and the eminent domain clause

plain: Michels says that Congressman Mike Turner, who represents the Ohio district home to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, which Michels calls "the center of all UFO lore and reverse engineering" (meaning the study of recovered craft to copy their technology) back to Roswell, counts defense contractors such as Boeing and Lockheed among his top donors. Michels raises this himself, without a source, in connection with the 2023 fight in Congress over a disclosure bill and its eminent domain clause, a provision that would have let the government take over privately held material, suggesting the contractors' ties helped explain opposition to it.
